security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU applies pointer masking (PM) uniformly to all values written to *tval CSRs during trap delivery, without distinguishing between explicit memory access addresses (which should be PM-masked) and instruction fetch addresses/PCs (which must NOT be PM-masked since PM does not apply to instruction fetches).
security_spec.summary: *tval CSR writes must apply pointer masking only to faulting data addresses (load/store) but NOT to instruction addresses (PC on fetch faults, breakpoints, illegal instructions), since PM does not apply to instruction fetches.
